object.attr: derived: CF-E31. An external image would put a local file into a distributed PDF or fetch from the network. MELLON-STORE-SRS-231 stops reading such references and MELLON-STORE-SRS-233 reports an entity; this stops the file coming in (D-E22).
object.description: If an SVG file to attach as a figure declares an entity or refers to another file or a network resource to load when drawn, Mellon shall refuse to attach the file.
